rendered: Yes, the value matches a row of Table 2[1]: the prodigiosin entry that integrates precursor genes to enhance precursor supply. Its titer cell reads 5830[2] mg/L, its time cell reads 96[3] h, its strain cell reads JNB5–1 → SMCH[4], and its reference cell reads [101][5]. The prose sentence cites the same reference and the same value. The strain names do not match: the prose says the the engineered strain PG yielded[6] value, while the table names that row SMCH. PG appears in the table only as a different entry, JNB5–1 → PG-6[7], which the text separately calls PG-6 in its Pan et al. sentence, so PG and SMCH are not the same name in the document. The text's comparison to wild type has no counterpart in Table 2[8].
